request.idea: Maya and Leo discover a glowing lantern in an old castle courtyard. Together they follow clues through the castle to discover why its magical lights have disappeared.

bible.title: The Lantern’s Missing Path
bible.narrativeComplexity: a problem with a consequence the reader can connect, with a feeling allowed under the action
bible.userIdea: Maya and Leo discover a glowing lantern in an old castle courtyard. Together they follow clues through the castle to discover why its magical lights have disappeared.

bible.premise: In an old castle courtyard, maya and Leo discover a glowing lantern whose light stops at a broken silver trail. Together they follow clues through the castle to discover why its magical lights have disappeared, and repair the trail without crushing the ivy growing beneath it.
bible.hook: One lantern still shines, but its silver path stops before the dark doorway home.
bible.goal: Repair the lantern’s silver path and light the doorway home before daylight fades.
bible.centralProblem: Growing ivy has lifted a connecting plate, stopping the lantern’s light from reaching the castle lamps.
bible.stakes: The courtyard arches look alike in the fading light; without the lamps, the children cannot recognize their way home.
emotionalArc: Maya follows a shimmer with her fingertip.
Leo checks their way back before entering the castle.
Maya stops pressing when Leo notices the trapped ivy.
They give each other different jobs to complete the repair.
They leave the lantern behind and walk along its light.
bible.motif: A thread of amber light running along silver.
